content.title: 2020 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Valvular Heart Disease
key_points: Bridging therapy is discussed in the context of anticoagulation management.
Various studies and trials compare effectiveness and safety of different anticoagulants such as warfarin, dabigatran, and apixaban.
Issues related to valve thrombosis, embolic complications, and surgical considerations are highlighted.
The role of direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) and low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) in perioperative settings are reviewed.
The use of novel agents like idarucizumab and andexanet alfa for reversal of anticoagulation effects is mentioned.
